title: Share card says "join the beta on TestFlight"
tryIt: Daily Ayah → reveal → Share → the line under the shukr mark

title: The explore button opens in place
tryIt: Open the map → tap the magnifying glass → Qibla · Prayers · Mosques fan out
Tap the map to fold it back

title: My masajid: star the mosques you pray at
tryIt: Mosques → open a mosque → tap ☆
The list shows it under MY MASAJID and its pin has a star

title: Jumu'ah at a masjid scores full
tryIt: On a Friday, mark Dhuhr while at a masjid → it reads Jumu'ah with a small mosque mark

title: The "fine" ring is the tasbeeh default
tryIt: Start a freestyle zikr → the thin glowing ring

title: Jumu'ah is instant at your own masajid
tryIt: At a starred masjid on Friday, mark Dhuhr → the moment says Jumu'ah straight away

title: Filter prayer pins to "Only at a masjid"
tryIt: Map → Prayers → the range menu → Only at a masjid

title: Duas when you arrive at / leave your masajid
tryIt: Settings → Masjid → turn on Duas at my masajid (asks for Always location)
Tap Preview the notification

title: Welcome to Makkah / Madinah
tryIt: Only in Makkah or Madinah: open the app → a welcome notification

title: "Early" is now "Perfect"; Jumu'ah shows no grade
tryIt: Mark a prayer in its first 30 min → "Perfect · 100"
Long-press a prayed prayer → the editor says Perfect

title: The Prayers widget shows NEXT like the app
tryIt: Mark the current prayer → the widget shows NEXT over the next prayer with a dashed ring

title: The time editor opens on the time you saved
tryIt: Long-press a prayed prayer → the wheel shows its saved time, not now

title: Change where you prayed
tryIt: Long-press a prayed prayer → tap the location → drag the map → Set location → Save

title: Build stamp under the menu and Settings
tryIt: Open the ☰ menu → the small line at the bottom shows version, build time and commit

title: Each prayer gets its own page in the map sheet
tryIt: Map → Prayers → tap a cluster → tap a prayer → its page slides in and its pin lifts out

title: Type an address when moving a pin
tryIt: While moving a prayer's pin, tap the address → type a place → pick a suggestion
The card says how far it is from where you marked it

title: Edits keep what the app recorded
tryIt: Change a prayer's time → reopen the editor → "You marked it at … · use that"

title: Mosques open inside the list sheet
tryIt: Map → Mosques → tap a mosque in the list → its page slides in → back returns to the list

title: No empty row above a mosque's name
tryIt: Open a mosque from the list → back button sits beside the name

title: The mosque sheet shrinks to a bar instead of closing
tryIt: Map → Mosques → the sheet opens at once
Swipe it down → a slim bar stays; ✕ goes back to the qibla

title: Edit a prayer from its page
tryIt: Open a prayer's page on the map → Edit → the same sheet shows the time wheel and location

title: Quieter prayer page, and when the window ended
tryIt: Open a prayer's page → "… after the window ended at 4:10 PM" and a small gray Edit

title: The filter menu is gone
tryIt: Mosque list header: just drive / walk and ✕
Long-press a mosque → Don't recommend still works

title: The moving pin points at the right spot
tryIt: Edit a prayer → Change location → the pin's tip sits exactly on where you prayed

title: Smooth edit transitions, and Back to the pin
tryIt: Prayer page → Edit → Change location → Cancel → Cancel: the sheet glides between sizes
Pan away from the prayer's pin → tap "Back to Dhuhr"

title: Fajr notifications work again, a week ahead
tryIt: After Isha, check tomorrow's "Fajr Time" arrives
Tap "Nudge in 10 minutes", open the app → the nudge still comes

title: NEXT no longer moves the prayer name
tryIt: Watch the circle as a prayer starts → the name stays put, NEXT fades above it

title: A soft moment when a prayer begins (3 looks to pick from)
tryIt: Keep the app open as a prayer starts → crossfade + a soft tap
Settings → My Dev Stuff → Prayer begins: fade / draw / glow

title: Filter names by All · Learning · Known
tryIt: ☰ → 99 Names → tap Known
··· → Reset progress (asks first)

title: Give a zikr task its own name
tryIt: Zikr → long-press a task → tap it → type a name like "After Fajr" → Save
The circle shows the name with the mantra under it

title: Reminders for zikr tasks
tryIt: Edit a task → Reminder → Around a prayer (e.g. 10 min after Fajr) → Save
When it fires, try Start now / Later / Skip today

title: What's new: tap the build line
tryIt: ☰ menu → tap the build line at the bottom → this page
Tick an item as tested → turn on Untested only
